exif: The redaction pass wrote these five without carrying the EXIF over, so they shipped with zero tags while the manifest still recorded their 35mm-equivalent focal length - the one camera parameter every measurement here needs, and the reader had no way to check it. Found 2026-09-21 by the pipeline returning focal_px=None on exactly these five. Repaired by copying the original APP1 segment back in, which leaves the compressed data untouched: the masked pixels are bit-identical to the reviewed files, asserted above before the hashes were rewritten. The reinstated EXIF was audited on its own terms - GPS present but degenerate (0/0), no serial, owner, copyright, artist or software tag, and a Xiaomi MakerNote of at most 88 bytes whose only readable string is 'Xiaomi'.
